Methods

@IsTest
private static void generatePdfFutureTest()

Verifies that generatePdfFuture asynchronously creates a QuoteDocument record for the given Quote. Injects PDF template settings via CodeSettings.setValue and validates the document is persisted after the future method completes.

@IsTest
private static void generatePdfInvalidTest()

Verifies that generatePdf returns a failed PdfResult when an invalid Id (non-Quote) is provided.

@IsTest
private static void generatePdfNullTest()

Verifies that generatePdf returns a failed PdfResult when a null quote Id is provided.

@IsTest
private static void generatePdfTest()

Verifies that generatePdf creates a QuoteDocument record for the given Quote. Uses CodeSettings.setValue to inject the PDF template configuration and relies on the Test.isRunningTest() branch in QuoteService to bypass PageReference.getContentAsPDF().
